review.verdict: Curse of Recklessness up, bottom half on damage
review.summary: 93 Curses of Recklessness. Seventh on Jeklik, 9th to 11th everywhere else. No consumables.

review.verdict: 75 dispels, the most in the raid by 30
review.summary: 75 dispels: 32 Venom Spits, 9 Poisonous Bloods, 7 Tranquilizing Poisons, 5 Hexes and more. Healing was on the low side (third on Venoxis, mostly fifth or sixth), which is what dispelling that much costs. No deaths.

review.verdict: Last on five bosses, 11 Curses of Blood removed
review.summary: 11 Curses of Blood removed. Last on Venoxis, Mar'li, Mandokir, Jin'do and Hakkar.

review.verdict: Second on Venoxis and Mar'li, survived two Gazes
review.summary: Second on Venoxis and Mar'li, third on Thekal and Jin'do. Mandokir's Gaze twice and you survived both. 4 interrupts, 76 Sunders, 3.6 consumables per pull, the most of the damage dealers.

review.verdict: Most healing on Jeklik, Venoxis and Jin'do
review.summary: First of the healers on Jeklik, Venoxis and Jin'do (32% of the raid's healing there), second on Thekal. 27 dispels including 9 Thunderclaps.

review.verdict: Most healing on Mar'li, 9 Power Infusions
review.summary: First of the healers on Mar'li (26%), second on Jin'do, third on Arlokk and Hakkar. 9 Power Infusions, 7 Fear Wards. Died to Unstable Concoction on the first trash.

review.verdict: Second on Arlokk, third on Venoxis
review.summary: Second on Arlokk (1159/s), third on Venoxis, fourth on Thekal. 4 interrupts. 8 Sunders.

review.verdict: Main tank, most damage on Arlokk, five Hakkar mind controls
review.summary: Main tank on seven of the eight, with Arlokk's top damage (1376/s) on the side. Hakkar mind-controlled you all five times and nobody died for it. No consumables.

review.verdict: Most damage on Mar'li and Thekal
review.summary: First on Mar'li (847/s) and Thekal (788/s), first of the damage dealers on Arlokk (1268/s), second on Jeklik, third on Hakkar. 115 Sunders. No deaths.

good.title: Damage
good.text: First on two bosses, and top of the damage dealers on a third.

review.verdict: Most damage on Venoxis and Jin'do
review.summary: First on Venoxis (918/s) and Jin'do (809/s), second on Hakkar, third on Mar'li. 7 Curses of Blood and 3 Delusions removed. No damage on Jeklik at all.

fix.title: Jeklik
fix.text: No damage on the kill. If you weren't there yet, fine.

review.verdict: 45 dispels, most healing on Arlokk
review.summary: 45 dispels, second in the raid: 23 Venom Spits, 8 Poisonous Bloods. First of the healers on Arlokk, third on Mandokir. Last of the healers on the first three bosses.

fix.title: First three bosses
fix.text: Last of the healers on Jeklik, Venoxis and Mar'li.

review.verdict: Fourth on Jeklik, mid-pack elsewhere
review.summary: Fourth on Jeklik, fifth on Mandokir and Hakkar. 10th on Venoxis.

review.verdict: Four interrupts, last on Thekal and Arlokk
review.summary: 4 interrupts and 54 Sunders. Last on Thekal and Arlokk, 11th on Venoxis and Hakkar.

review.verdict: Most healing on Mandokir and Thekal, top three on all eight
review.summary: First of the healers on Mandokir and Thekal, second on Jeklik, Venoxis, Mar'li, Arlokk and Hakkar, third on Jin'do: over a fifth of the raid's healing on every boss. Died to a Bat Rider's Unstable Concoction on the first trash.

good.title: Healing
good.text: Top three of six healers on every boss.

fix.title: Trash
fix.text: Unstable Concoction at the start, along with two other healers.

review.verdict: Most damage on Jeklik, second on Mandokir and Jin'do
review.summary: First on Jeklik (716/s), second on Mandokir and Jin'do, third on Arlokk. 3 interrupts. No deaths.

review.verdict: Off-tank on all eight
review.summary: Off-tank on seven bosses and main tank on Hakkar. 69 Sunders. No deaths, no consumables.

review.verdict: Third on Mandokir, four interrupts
review.summary: Third on Mandokir, fourth on Arlokk, 4 interrupts. 11th on Jin'do. 0.6 consumables per pull.

review.verdict: Most damage on Mandokir and Hakkar, 3 Delusions removed
review.summary: First on Mandokir (738/s) and Hakkar (655/s), second on Thekal, third on Jeklik. Removed 3 Delusions on Jin'do and 7 Curses of Blood, kicked 2 Drain Lifes. No deaths.

review.verdict: Bottom half on most bosses
review.summary: Fifth on Jin'do. 10th or 11th on Mar'li, Arlokk and Hakkar. One interrupt.

fix.title: Damage
fix.text: Bottom three on Mar'li, Arlokk and Hakkar.

review.verdict: Most healing on Hakkar
review.summary: First of the healers on Hakkar (23%), second on Mandokir. 6 Power Infusions. Died to Unstable Concoction on the first trash. Jin'do was low (last, 45 HPS).
